name: MM-VET-Bench-pt-v2
description: MM-VET-Bench-pt-v2 is a Portuguese multimodal evaluation benchmark designed to test models' ability to reason across image and Portuguese text inputs. It contains examples targeting visual entailment/visual reasoning and related classification tasks in Portuguese, enabling evaluation of multilingual and multimodal models. The benchmark is intended for measuring cross-modal understanding and robustness on language-specific multimodal tasks.
reputation: Language-specific multimodal benchmark hosted on Hugging Face with limited but growing use for Portuguese model evaluation.
